4112a8b21d62.title: Mandatory access control
4112a8b21d62.sentence: In computer security, mandatory access control (MAC) refers to a type of access control by which a secured environment (e.g., an operating system or a database) constrains the ability of a subject or initiator to access or modify on an object or target.

4c704ad3c447.title: Mandatory access control
4c704ad3c447.sentence: Subjects and objects each have a set of security attributes.

83f232f1748e.title: Mandatory access control
83f232f1748e.sentence: Whenever a subject attempts to access an object, the operating system kernel examines these security attributes, examines the authorization rules (aka policy) in place, and decides whether to grant access.

e4f5c258641b.title: gh>ByteByteGoHq/system-design-101/data/guides/how-do-we-design-a-permission-system.md
e4f5c258641b.sentence: Both resource owners and resources have classification labels.

9aac8d36dd10.title: gh>ByteByteGoHq/system-design-101/data/guides/how-do-we-design-a-permission-system.md
9aac8d36dd10.sentence: Different labels are granted with different permissions.

bd992879c641.title: Mandatory access control
bd992879c641.sentence: In mandatory access control, the security policy is centrally controlled by a policy administrator and is guaranteed (in principle) to be enforced for all users.

9769d5e526c3.title: Mandatory access control
9769d5e526c3.sentence: Users cannot override the policy and, for example, grant access to files that would otherwise be restricted.

3a4166fdfe6f.title: Mandatory access control
3a4166fdfe6f.sentence: By contrast, discretionary access control (DAC), which also governs the ability of subjects to access objects, allows users the ability to make policy decisions or assign security attributes.

5661cfc02121.title: Mandatory access control
5661cfc02121.sentence: Historically and traditionally, MAC has been closely associated with multilevel security (MLS) and specialized military systems.

730ef23038a3.title: Mandatory access control
730ef23038a3.sentence: The Trusted Computer System Evaluation Criteria (TCSEC), the seminal work on the subject and often known as the Orange Book, provided the original definition of MAC as "a means of restricting access to objects based on the sensitivity (as represented by a label) of the information contained in the objects and the formal authorization (i.e., clearance) of subjects to access information of such sensitivity".

85dc55fc8846.title: Mandatory access control
85dc55fc8846.sentence: The more recent MAC implementations, such as SELinux and AppArmor for Linux and Mandatory Integrity Control for Windows, allow administrators to focus on issues such as network attacks and malware without the rigor or constraints of MLS.

8c12470f1164.title: Mandatory access control
8c12470f1164.sentence: SELinux provides powerful fine-grained control which makes it suitable for high-security environments, but many users find that its power and granularity come with a high degree of complexity and a steep learning curve.

3f509cee5667.title: Role-based access control

3f509cee5667.sentence: Relationship-based access control (ReBAC) is a model that evolves from RBAC.

7e68e988e169.title: Role-based access control
7e68e988e169.section: Relation to other models > Relationship-based access control
7e68e988e169.sentence: In ReBAC, a subject's permission to access a resource is defined by the presence of relationships between those subjects and resources.

f079e5405832.title: Role-based access control
f079e5405832.section: Relation to other models > Relationship-based access control
f079e5405832.sentence: The advantage of this model is that allows for fine-grained permissions; for example, in a social network where users can share posts with other specific users.

cc2e06f7a6fa.title: Attribute-based access control
cc2e06f7a6fa.sentence: Attributes can be compared to static values or to one another, thus enabling relation-based access control.

1a4a31a40900.title: XACML
1a4a31a40900.sentence: With conditions, it is possible to implement segregation of duty checks or relationship-based access control.

bbbe3db65176.title: Role-based access control
bbbe3db65176.section: Relation to other models > Comparing to ACL
bbbe3db65176.sentence: RBAC has been shown to be particularly well suited to separation of duties (SoD) requirements, which ensure that two or more people must be involved in authorizing critical operations.

ab070a9719b7.title: Role-based access control
ab070a9719b7.section: Relation to other models > Comparing to ACL
ab070a9719b7.sentence: An underlying principle of SoD is that no individual should be able to effect a breach of security through dual privilege.

26b785c7305a.title: Role-based access control
26b785c7305a.section: Relation to other models > Comparing to ACL
26b785c7305a.sentence: By extension, no person may hold a role that exercises audit, control or review authority over another, concurrently held role.

8d88bafeec4f.title: Role-based access control
8d88bafeec4f.sentence: For example, the same person should not be allowed to both create a login account and to authorize the account creation.

1e0059665b92.title: rfc>2904
1e0059665b92.sentence: Authorization is itself a security mechanism.

a603c99ba922.title: rfc>2904
a603c99ba922.sentence: As such, it is important that authorization protocols cannot easily be abused to circumvent the protection they are intended to ensure.

4f7e959cbdea.title: rfc>2904
4f7e959cbdea.sentence: However, working groups such as Roamops and MobileIP have identified requirements to minimize Internet traversals in order to reduce latency.

9889caeaf7d3.title: rfc>2904
9889caeaf7d3.sentence: To support these requirements, data fields necessary for both authentication and authorization SHOULD be able to be carried in a single message set.
